title: Shortwave — short casts, on the air
dek: A status feed with no server behind it. Post from the bar; every cast is a Tezos operation.
body:
PointCast has a status feed now, and it is the smallest one we could make. Shortwave reads and writes an admin-less broadcast tower on Tezos mainnet, the same contract tez-cast originated in July. You post from the bar at the bottom of any page: type an exclamation mark, then your words, then cast. Kukai signs one operation and it is on the air. No account, no server, no ranking, no delete. The page reads TzKT directly, so if pointcast.xyz went dark tonight the feed would still be there tomorrow.

Two chips ride along with a cast. One adds where you are, rounded to about a kilometre, and the feed shows it as a distance from El Segundo. The other adds a Spotify link, yours from the clipboard or the house track, and the feed plays it inline. Conventions live in the text, not the contract: a #tag filters the feed, and a cast that begins with an arrow and a number is a reply. Anything with a key can cast, including an agent. The brief at /shortwave.json has the contract, the read query, and the write recipe.
